_provenance.description: One deposited structure per trivalent lanthanide, chosen by measuring candidates rather than by resolution or by title. A structure is admitted when it has at least one site of that element which geometry-v2 calls lanthanide-like with a reliable call, which excludes the soaked chelate complexes that make up most of the index. These are NOT design-rule candidates: nothing here was screened for the lanmodulin architecture, and being listed means only that the protein is measurably holding the element.
